articles.title: GPT-5.6 Luna Became ChatGPT's Default Free Model
articles.summary: OpenAI removed limits on text-based chats and made GPT-5.6 Luna the default model for Free and Go users. Separate limits remain for files, images, voice, and image generation. A new Think button adds optional higher reasoning.

articles.title: AMD to Acquire AI Chip Startup Taalas
articles.summary: AMD agreed to acquire Toronto-based Taalas, whose custom silicon hardwires AI models to reduce inference compute and memory bottlenecks. Financial terms were undisclosed, and the deal remains subject to regulatory approval.

articles.title: WeatherNext: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
articles.summary: WeatherNext is an AI model that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in predicting a cyclone's track, intensity, and wind structure. The model gives forecasters, on average, an extra day's worth of predictive accuracy compared to current methods. Google has open-sourced its WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones models to empower the research community and amplify AI's impact on building more resilient communities. The research has already had real-world impact - it predicted Hurricane Melissa's rapid intensification and landfall in Jamaica during the 2025 hurricane season, enabling advanced warnings to be issued and giving teams on the ground critical time to prepare.

articles.title: How Modalities Learn Together
articles.summary: Meta researchers explored how modalities learn together during pretraining. They also identified architectures that promote cross-modal synergy and recipes that achieved strong generation performance with 5% of the compute budget.
